field.label: Enabled
field.help: A row that is switched off is ignored, and the key keeps its default action.

field.label: Key
field.help: The key's name, as the panel's driver reports it: Enter, Escape, Up and Down on the Sophos panels. A press is matched to its row by this name.

field.label: Printed on the key
field.help: What the key says on the panel, so the row is easy to find. The learning shows it on the glass when it asks for this key.

field.label: Code
field.help: The byte this key sends, as two hexadecimal digits. Only panels whose bridge sends a byte by itself have one - the XGS 3300 does - and the plugin then reads the port itself. Leave it empty to use the code the appliance table measured, or use Learn the codes to read it from the panel.

field.label: Action
field.help: What a press does while the screens rotate. In the menu the arrows move, Enter opens and Escape goes back, whatever is chosen here.

field.label: Screen
field.help: The screen this key shows, for the action Show one screen.
